newsitem.title: USA: NCR sees second quarter results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: NCR sees second quarter results below estimates.

text.p: NCR Corp. said Tuesday its earnings for the second quarter will likely fall short of analysts' estimates, primarily because of weak services revenues and disappointing orders for its hardware systems.

The computer systems and services company, which was spun off from AT&T at the end of last year, said it expected improved results for the period compared with a year ago, when it lost $18 million or 18 cents per share.
However, it said revenue and margin pressures for services and an expected shortfall in systems orders would leave its earnings short of Wall Street estimates for the period.
Analysts had expected NCR to earn 11 cents per share in the quarter, according to First Call, which monitors industry earnings outlooks.
NCR, which plans to report its results on July 16, said orders at its core business are expected to rise for the quarter but revenues are seen flat versus a year ago, both on a local currency basis.
NCR said it remained optimistic it could show growth in orders and revenue in its core businesses, as well as improve its operating income and earnings per share.
